acip: GANG DU RAB RIB CAN GYIS SKRA SHAD DE MTHONG BA'I YUL DER MIG NI RJES SU 'BREL BA STE GTAD PA'I RAB RIB MED PA LA'ANG RAB RIB CAN DANG 'DRA BAR SKRA SHAD MTHONG BA'I BLO SKYE BAR 'GYUR TE, YUL MED PAR MTSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
english: The object which was such that the person with the cataracts saw it as a strand of hair would have to have an eye which was connected with it; that is, which was attending to it. And in that case, even a person who had no cataracts would also give rise to a state of mind where they saw a strand of hair, in the same way that the the person with the cataracts did. And this is because the object is equally a non-entity, in both cases.
